capabilities: Organize manuscript sheets with a hierarchical Binder, Cards, Outline, Story arcs and Timeline
Write several files as one continuous editable manuscript with goals and Focus Mode
Document projects with Research folders, BibTeX citations and bibliography
Proofread with annotations, snapshots, version comparison and review packages
Compose and export to Markdown, DOCX, EPUB, ODT and PDF
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; full documentation lives in a separate docs index; optional companion plugins (Feuillets CSL, Feuillets-Grammalecte, Courrier, Advanced Canvas) extend citations, French grammar checking, submissions and Canvas features.
problem: Obsidian has no dedicated workflow for structuring, writing, revising and publishing a long manuscript split across many files.

relations.evidence: Feuillets CSL — Optional native Citation Style Language engine for BibTeX/Pandoc citations and CSL bibliographies.
Optional local French spelling and grammar checking, with live correction in the editor and Continuous mode
Optional editorial submissions and correspondence workflow.
Advanced Canvas — Enhanced Canvas features for Notebook and research visualization.

summary: Long-form writing studio that turns Markdown folders into manuscripts with a Binder, continuous multi-file editing, research, proofreading, preview and export.
